evidence_inputs.q_test_use: only for the one-shot as-recorded validation; no scheduler tuning

lambda_selection: choose only from clean D/Q training-pool OOF simulation; do not select from Test or participant evaluation outcomes

information_gain_variant.definition: For each candidate group, compute ideal binary-partition entropy H2(p(group)); apply the same exploration floor after normalization.

target_mix.definition: Within each generated text block, sample one quarter of targets from the bottom quartile of the fixed LM next-character prior; sample the remainder from the prior distribution.

simulation_metrics: flashes per character at matched accuracy
calibration error under non-uniform flash density
calibration_sensitivity: compare uniform-trained score calibration with group-density-stratified calibration under each locked scheduler mode; do not recalibrate on evaluation outcomes
matched_accuracy_rule: report comparisons only at operating points with absolute accuracy difference <= 0.01; otherwise report unmatched
leakage_test: scheduler state and call signatures must not accept target or true character; rerun spy test against final code
decision: Choose row/column adaptive repetition versus group-flash subsets only from the locked simulation. If G3 fails, keep uniform live flashing.

gate_decision.g3: no-go: D simulator known-result validation failed by 0.179 absolute accuracy against the preregistered 0.05 tolerance; no four-scheduler outcome simulation or lambda selection was run

leave_subject_out_curve.fit_scope: all subjects except each rotating validation subject; empirical target/non-target score distributions are study-pooled across training subjects only
leave_subject_out_curve.pass_rule: mean absolute error across depth points <= 0.10 and maximum pointwise absolute error <= 0.15 for each study-level curve

simulator_validation.limitation: i.i.d. flash-logit sampling ignores within-character temporal dependence, adaptation, fatigue, and nonstationary artifacts
